〖360° Surround Sound〗: TRIBIT StormBox Mini+ delivers immersive 360° stereo sound with its left-right acoustic design. Equipped with two powerful 48mm full-range drivers, a passive radiator, and 12W output power, it also features built-in 2+1 Band Dynamic Range Control (DRC) to enhance clarity and balance, delivering clear, dynamic 2.0 stereo sound that brings your music to life.
〖Customizable Sound via TRIBIT App〗:Take control of your audio with the TRIBIT App—adjust the EQ or choose from 5 preset sound modes to match your preferences.

〖12-hour Power Marathon〗: Say goodbye to battery anxiety! With up to 12 hours of playtime ( at 50% volume and lights off), plus a quick 2.5-hour recharge via the convenient Type-C port, StormBox Mini+ keeps the music playing without interruption. Perfect for home lounging, picnics, mountain hikes, and any outdoor adventure.

〖Seamless Bluetooth 5.4 Connectivity〗: Enjoy smooth streaming with Bluetooth 5.4 and a reliable range of up to 30 meters (100 feet). With built-in AAC and SBC decoding, you’ll experience high-definition audio—AAC delivers clearer, more detailed sound, while SBC ensures broad compatibility with all Bluetooth-enabled devices. Plus, the AUX input offers extra flexibility for your gadgets.

〖True Wireless Stereo & Adventure-Ready〗:Pair two StormBox Mini+ speakers for immersive true wireless stereo sound. With IPX7 waterproof and dustproof protection, it's built for any adventure—from cycling trails to beach outings and outdoor workouts. Dynamic LED lights set the vibe, while the built-in mic lets you take calls hands-free on the go.
